'''Arleil Schous''' was an aging [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]]. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he was one main contacts for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was regarded as a leader of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] community of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Schous visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spacesport Cantina]] in Mos Eisley and sat in a booth with the patrons [[Bom Vimdin/Legends|Bom Vimdin]], [[Pons Limbic/Legends|Pons Limbic]], [[Hem Dazon/Legends|Hem Dazon]], and [[Braconnor Bakiska/Legends|Braconnor Bakiska]]. The group visited when the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sought passage to the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

Later, around [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], Schous attended the cantina while it was recorded live by the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] for live broadcast as part of the [[holodocumentary]] ''[[Life on Tatooine]]''. The mercenary sat at a table in the cantina when he was threatened by the [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Cyceyed]], who was removed shortly thereafter by the [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] [[Tork]]. When a curfew was placed on the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Standard day/Legends|nighttime]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]] attempted to get the patrons of the cantina, including Schous, to leave. Schous eventually left while Ackmena preformed her song "[[Goodnight, But Not Goodbye/Legends|Goodnight, But Not Goodbye]]."

==Biography==
===Alien leader and mercenary===
[[File:Defel_arleil.jpg|thumb|right|Arleil Schous was an aging mercenary.]]
The [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Arleil Schous was an aging<ref name="Schous" /> [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> who [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from<ref name="Defel" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="AfEl">{{CSWECite|I|13|Af'El}}</ref> [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]].<ref name="Defel" /> He was one of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] main contacts on<ref name="Schous" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CVD" /> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and was widely regarded as a leader of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] community in the<ref name="Schous" /> Tatooine [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="Mos Eisley">{{DB|location|moseisley|Mos Eisley}}</ref> [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="Schous" /> At some point in his life, Schous had lost the ability of warping light<ref name="Schous" /> around himself and becoming hard to view.<ref name="Defel" />

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Schous visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in Mos Eisley and sat in a booth with the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bom Vimdin/Legends|Bom Vimdin]],<ref name="Cracken">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] patron [[Pons Limbic/Legends|Pons Limbic]],<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|pack=#35: Pons Limbic|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLC35pons.asp}}</ref> [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Hem Dazon/Legends|Hem Dazon]],<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and the male patron [[Braconnor Bakiska/Legends|Braconnor Bakiska]].<ref name="BakiskaBlog">{{SW|url=news/meet-braconnor-bakiska|text=Meet Braconnor Bakiska}}</ref> The group visited the cantina when the<ref name="Episode IV" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] came and sought out a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to take them to the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Episode IV" /> Schous moved to a booth closer to the bar and met with the [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]]<ref name="CL" /> scout [[Ketwol/Legends|Ketwol]]<ref name="POTJ">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Ketwol|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjketwol.asp}}</ref> and the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]]<ref name="CL" /> [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]] over a jigger of [[Merenzane Gold/Legends|Merenzane Gold]].<ref name="CL" /> Schous and Kardue'sai'Malloc turned to stare<ref name="CL" /> at the altercation between Kenobi and the criminals [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] and [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] after Evazan threw Skywalker into a table<ref name="Episode IV" /> near the Defel's booth.<ref name="CL" />

===Cantina curfew===
[[File:Ackmenas_patrons.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Ackmena attempted to get her patrons to leave the cantina.]]
Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]],<ref name="LifeDate">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM|quote=Wookiee Life Day occurs every 3 years, one of which fell at ~1.5 ABY.}}</ref> Schous visited Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina when the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] took live footage of the establishment for the [[holodocumentary]] ''[[Life on Tatooine]]''. The footage was broadcasted to the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. While the<ref name="hs">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref> [[Standard day/Legends|nighttime]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]]<ref name="Ackmena">{{CSWECite|I|10|Ackmena}}</ref> [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]] tended to the cantina, the Defel sat with the<ref name="hs" /> [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Cyceyed]],<ref name="Who's Who">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-holiday-special-cantina-we-may-not-thrive-friend-but-we-survive-friend|text=''The Star Wars Holiday Special'' Cantina: Who's Who|int=The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who|nolive=1}}</ref> who produced a [[Knife/Legends|knife]]<ref name="hs" /> and threatened Schous,<ref name="Who's Who" /> causing the Abyssin to be forcibly removed from the cantina by the<ref name="hs" /> [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] [[Tork]].<ref name="Insider91">{{InsiderCite|91|Refresher Reading}}</ref> Shortly after, a curfew was placed on the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after activities from "subversive forces." Ackmena attempted to get her patrons to leave the cantina but was unsuccessful.<ref name="hs" /> Two individuals&mdash;the [[Stennes Shifter/Legends|Stennes Shifter]] [[Trinto Duaba/Legends|Trinto Duaba]] and Kardue'sai'Malloc&mdash;entered<ref name="Who's Who" /> the cantina after the latter threatened Ackmena with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. The two walked over to and sat with Schous.<ref name="hs" />

Schous, alongside Duaba, Kardue'sai'Malloc, and other patrons, then took part in a protest to stay in the cantina. Ackmena yielded and let them stay for one more round on the house. When the bartender sang her song "[[Goodnight, But Not Goodbye/Legends|Goodnight, But Not Goodbye]]," Tork served the trio at the table drinks and the group toasted together. Schous left the two at the table and exited the cantina before Ackmena finished her song.<ref name="hs" />

==Personality and traits==
Schous had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin, brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Episode IV" />

==Equipment==
While in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina<ref name="Episode IV" /> in 0 BBY,<ref name="NEC" /> the Defel mercenary<ref name="CVD" /> wore a tan [[Clothing/Legends|jacket]].<ref name="Episode IV" /> While visiting the cantina<ref name="hs" /> around 1.5 ABY,<ref name="LifeDate" /> Schous wore a red [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] over a cream-colored [[shirt]].<ref name="hs" />

==Behind the scenes==
His famous scene when his eyes glow red in the dark was replaced by [[Melas/Legends|Melas]], due to George Lucas' wish. However, Arleil may still be seen in the background behind [[Hem Dazon/Legends|Hem Dazon's]] introductory shot. "Arleil Schous" is an anagram of Charles Louis (Kallenbach), a Decipher employee. The character's mask was previously used for the obscure 1974 Halloween live show "In the Attic", with [[Rick Baker]] in the costume. In ''A New Hope'', Schous is portrayed by [[Kim Falkinburg]].<ref name="Archeology">{{YouTube|video=ElyMaaAFLKU|text=The Star Wars Cantina PT. 2 &#124; Full Panel #indianacomicconvention #tomspinadesigns #starwarshistory|channel=@FanXComicConventions|name=FanX Comic Conventions|date=2025-05-03}}</ref>

Schous was first given his name<ref name="Schous" /> in [[1998]]<ref name="Decipher">{{Decipher|url=starwars/whatisit/timeline.html|text=''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game Product Timeline}}</ref> with the release of the ''[[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]]'' for the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' produced by [[Decipher]].<ref name="Schous" />
